_about: Source-size ratchet (AITD-346), checked by scripts/check-source-contracts.mjs (rule source-file-size). No production file may cross `threshold` lines except those listed, and a listed file may not grow past its `lines`. Lowering an entry is always welcome; RAISING one is a decision with a reason in `why` — that reflex is how six files over 1,000 became nine. An entry whose file shrank more than `slack` below its ceiling must be lowered, so removed lines cannot quietly come back. Line counts are `wc -l` (newlines).
